scope: Complete SciFact test; exact retrieval over complete original corpus
limitations: This is a pretrained quantized model baseline; no Qwen weights were trained here.
Model pretraining contamination is not independently audited.
128-token budgets do not imply identical text coverage across the two tokenizers.
Cached historical inference timings may span runs; cache hits are never presented as fresh model throughput.
Dot-product-only ranking latency excludes model loading, document indexing, and query encoding.

encoder.truncation: right after instruction formatting, reserving final EOS position when enabled
encoder.query_instruction: Given a scientific claim, retrieve scientific abstracts that provide evidence about the claim.
encoder.eos_policy: explicit EOS after body truncation mirrors official automatic TemplateProcessing

teacher_vector_artifact.purpose: Frozen teacher cosine scores for separately preregistered train-only negative filtering
